newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease following US data.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease following US data.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased on Friday's U.S. data which were seen to hold out the possibility of a further US interest rate hike, dealers said.
They said trading was otherwise thin.

March U.S. producer prices slipped 0.1 percent while the rate without the volatile food and energy components rose 0.4 percent. Economists had expected overall PPI to remain flat, with a 0.1-percent core rate rise.
March retail sales firmed 0.2 percent, below the 0.6 percent rise expected.
MinFins closely track Brady Bonds and other emerging market debt.
"Figures, although quite neutral, are close to negative. U.S. Treasuries are being hit now and MinFins are tracking them, edging down," an International Moscow bank dealer said.
Moscow Business World Bank dealer Sergei Kovzharov said trading had been quiet earlier, as the market awaited U.S. data.
